stats.notes: Confirmed: a single tick 'pause+right' from a fresh game (seed 42) pauses the game (mode=paused, pause menu shown) but the player still moves from (1,1) to (2,1), with events [pause, move]. Design section 2 says pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (1,1). Replayed from a fresh game, and the single-token form is already the shortest reproduction. Budget is nearly spent, so I am finishing here. Not explored: enemies, spikes, dashes, dialogs, and score caps.
